Tired of delayed inputs ruining your matches? The GameSir Nova 2 Lite Multi-Platform Tri-Mode Wireless Game Controller (Luminous White) delivers fast response, flexible connectivity, and dependable control for competitive and casual gaming alike.

Whether you play on PC, Switch, Android, or iOS, this GameSir Gamepad offers broad compatibility without changing your gaming habits. Its Hall Effect technology, tri-mode connectivity, and customizable controls make it a practical choice for gamers searching for a reliable Multiplatform Gaming Controller. If you are looking for the GameSir Controller Price in Bangladesh, this model is available at PCB Store with trusted after-sales support across Bangladesh.

Why Choose the GameSir Nova 2 Lite Multi-Platform Tri-Mode Wireless Game Controller?

Modern games demand fast reactions. A controller with inconsistent inputs or stick drift quickly becomes frustrating. The GameSir Nova 2 Lite focuses on responsive performance by combining Hall Effect sticks, Hall Effect triggers, and a 1000Hz polling rate over wired and wireless dongle connections.

Its tri-mode connectivity supports Bluetooth, wireless dongle, and wired operation. That flexibility makes it an excellent PC and Mobile Game Controller for players who regularly switch between gaming platforms.

How Does the GameSir Nova 2 Lite Perform?

The controller uses GameSir Hall Effect sensing sticks, reducing the risk of stick drift while delivering consistent movement accuracy. Hall Effect triggers also provide smoother actuation and include trigger stops for players who prefer faster response during competitive gameplay.

Ultra-low button and stick latency helps commands register quickly. Combined with the mechanical circular D-pad, directional movements feel accurate during platformers, fighting games, and retro titles.

Dual asymmetric rumble motors add tactile feedback without affecting overall controller balance.

Key Features That Improve Everyday Gaming

Several practical features separate this controller from standard wireless gamepads.

  • Tri-mode connectivity with Bluetooth, wireless dongle, and wired support
  • Hall Effect sticks designed for long-term durability
  • Hall Effect triggers with adjustable trigger stops
  • Mechanical circular D-pad for responsive directional inputs
  • 1000Hz polling rate through wired and wireless dongle modes
  • Dual macro back buttons supporting mapping and macro recording
  • Dual asymmetric vibration motors
  • Anti-slip laser-textured grips
  • Full customization through GameSir Connect App and GameSir App

The included 600mAh rechargeable battery also supports the optional smart auto start-stop charging station, compatible with the Super Nova charging dock.

entry.title: 8BitDo Pro 2 Bluetooth Gaming Controller for Switch, PC, Android, and Steam & Apple
entry.summary:
Vendor: 8BitDo
Type: Video Game Console Accessories
Price: 55.00

Play like a Pro with 8BitDo's most advanced controller to date! An evolution of the SN30 Pro+ in every way at a fraction of the price of competitor Pro controllers and compatible with the Raspberry Pi!

The Pro 2 features two Pro-level back buttons. These buttons give you more control so you don't have to take your thumbs off the thumbsticks. With 8BitDo Ultimate Software you can assign any button function and macros, too.

More ways to play. Custom Profile Switching. Enhanced grip. 4-way Mode Switching button.

The Pro 2 gives you more ways to play. The custom profile switch button holds 3 custom profiles that can be switched on the fly. With an enhanced grip, Pro 2 allows you to hold the controller with even less effort. The new 4-way Mode Switch button allows you to instantly switch between Switch, macOS, D-input and X-input so you can pair to any device as easily as possible.

8BitDo Ultimate Software now on PC, Android and iOS

Ultimate Software gives you elite control over every piece of your controller - now on Android and iOS. Customize button mapping, adjust stick & trigger sensitivity, vibration control and create macros with any button combination. Create controller profiles and switch between them at any time with the custom profile switch.¹

  • Mapping: Assign the buttons with the functionality to your liking

  • Sticks: Customize each stick for a higher precision control

  • Triggers: Adjust the ranges of your triggers to act faster

  • Vibration: Modify the vibration intensity for a better comfort during gameplay

  • Macros: Assign a long sequence and action to one single button

A Modern controller that respects the classics

The Pro 2 controller isn't any old Bluetooth® game controller - it was designed with respect for the classics. We paid extra attention to the most critical characteristics like the D-PAD, to make sure it feels exactly like you remember it.

Play any game, anywhere

Switch. Windows. macOS. Android. 8Bitdo controllers are designed to be as versatile as possible with each of your modern devices. Now with a 4-way mode switch, you can instantly pair your controller via Bluetooth®. You can even use Pro 2 as a wired USB controller with the included USB cable.

Compatibility

  • Raspberry Pi: 4B, 3B+, 3B, 2B, Zero (Bluetooth® 2.0 and above)
  • Switch: 1.0.0 and above (Switch), 9.0.0 and above (Lite)
  • Windows: Windows 7 and above (Bluetooth®4.0
  • macOS: 10.10 and above
  • Android: 4.0 and above
  • Steam: Windows 7 and above, macOS 10.9 and above

Package Contents

  • 8BitDo Pro 2 Bluetooth gamepad
  • USB cable
  • Instruction manual

Tech Specs

Special Features

  • 2 Pro back paddle buttons
  • Custom Profile switch button, 3 profiles, switch on the fly
  • Mode switch button (Switch, macOS, D-input, X-input)
  • Ultimate Software on PC and mobile (Android/iOS)
  • Enhanced grip
  • Modifiable vibration
  • 6 axis motion sensor

Connectivity

  • Wireless Bluetooth®4.0
  • USB-C

Controller Mode

  • Switch mode
  • X-input
  • Mac mode
  • D-input

Battery Type / Battery Life

  • 1000mAh Li-on battery, rechargeable
  • 20 play hours with 4 hour charging time

Notes

* Additional system support requires downloading and installing firmware available at support.8bitdo.com
* Switch compatibility does not support HD rumble or amiibo scanning
¹ The Pro 2 features regular rumble vibration, not HD Rumble.
